qa_pairs.question: Please compare the changing trend of the market size from 2022 to 2025 in the 'Market Size of Spicy Snacks in China from 2022 to 2026 (in billions of yuan)' with the changing trend of the average spiciness (SHU) of the three styles of Spicy → Sour - Spicy → Peppery in the 'Percentage of Preferences for the World's TOP 3 Popular Spicy Flavors, Average Spiciness (SHU) of Different Spicy Styles'. Are the trends of these two curves consistent? Please answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: The market size increased continuously from 2022 → 2023 → 2024 → 2025. Meanwhile, the average spiciness of the three styles also increased from 250 SHU → 750 SHU → 1250 SHU. Both curves are monotonically increasing, so the trends are consistent.

qa_pairs.question: From the sequence of Spicy → Sour - Spicy → Peppery in the 'Percentage of Preferences for the World's TOP 3 Popular Spicy Flavors, Average Spiciness (SHU) of Different Spicy Styles', the preference percentage decreased continuously. Please indicate the name of the spicy style corresponding to the first decrease in the preference percentage but the continuous rise in the market size. Just write the name without additional description.
qa_pairs.explanation: The preference percentage decreased from 45% for Spicy to 35% for Sour - Spicy, showing the first decrease. Meanwhile, the market size increased from 1804 billion yuan in 2022 to 2045 billion yuan in 2023, still rising. Therefore, the divergence point corresponds to Sour - Spicy.
